_readme: Questions about MySQL_Handbook.pdf. Labeled questions (must_contain = phrase copied from the passage that answers it) feed eval/retrieval_eval.py. Questions with no label are deliberately NOT answerable from the document: retrieval_eval skips them, run_eval uses them to check the model says it does not know instead of hallucinating. Phrases were verified against pypdf's extraction of the PDF.

questions.question: What is a database in MySQL and how does the handbook compare it to a folder?
questions.ground_truth: A database is a container that stores related data in an organized way.
must_contain: stores related data in an organized way

questions.question: What SQL command deletes an entire database and all its tables?
questions.ground_truth: DROP DATABASE startersql; deletes the whole database and everything in it.

questions.question: What does the ENUM data type do?
questions.ground_truth: ENUM is a string object whose value is chosen from a list of permitted values, e.g. gender ENUM('Male','Female','Other').
must_contain: string object with a value chosen from a list

questions.question: What does DECIMAL(10, 2) store?
questions.ground_truth: Exact numeric data, where 10 is the total number of digits and 2 the digits after the decimal point; useful for financial data.

questions.question: What does the AUTO_INCREMENT constraint do?
questions.ground_truth: It automatically generates a unique number for each new row.
must_contain: automatically generates a unique number for each row

questions.question: How do I rename a table in MySQL?
questions.ground_truth: Use RENAME TABLE old_name TO new_name, e.g. RENAME TABLE users TO customers.

questions.question: How do I add a new column to an existing table?
questions.ground_truth: Use ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN, e.g. ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE.

questions.question: How can I move a column to the first position of a table?
questions.ground_truth: Use ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY COLUMN ... FIRST.

questions.question: Why is it better to specify column names when inserting rows?
questions.ground_truth: It is safer and more readable, and is the best practice, especially if the table structure changes later.

questions.question: How do I insert several rows with a single statement?
questions.ground_truth: Provide multiple value tuples in one INSERT INTO ... VALUES statement, which is more efficient than inserting one by one.

questions.question: How do I select users whose name starts with the letter A?
questions.ground_truth: Use LIKE 'A%'.

questions.question: How do I skip the first 5 rows and return the next 10 rows?
questions.ground_truth: Use LIMIT 10 OFFSET 5, or LIMIT 5, 10.

questions.question: How do I find rows where a column has no value?
questions.ground_truth: Use IS NULL (and IS NOT NULL for the opposite).

questions.question: What happens if I run UPDATE without a WHERE clause?
questions.ground_truth: It updates every row in the table, so be very careful.
must_contain: updates every row in the table

questions.question: What does the handbook recommend before running a DELETE?
questions.ground_truth: Run a SELECT with the same WHERE clause first to confirm which rows will be affected, and back up important data.
must_contain: Consider running a SELECT with the same WHERE

questions.question: What is the difference between DELETE FROM users and DROP TABLE users?
questions.ground_truth: DELETE FROM users removes all rows but keeps the table structure; DROP TABLE removes the structure and data permanently.
must_contain: removes the table structure and all data permanently

questions.question: How do I add a CHECK constraint to restrict dates of birth?
questions.ground_truth: ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT chk_dob CHECK (date_of_birth > '2000-01-01').

questions.question: How do I change an existing column so it cannot be NULL?
questions.ground_truth: ALTER TABLE users MODIFY COLUMN name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL.
must_contain: Change an existing column to NOT NULL

questions.question: Which MySQL function counts rows?
questions.ground_truth: COUNT(), e.g. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users.

questions.question: How can I calculate a user's age in years?
questions.ground_truth: Use TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, CURDATE()).

questions.question: How do I combine a name and an email into a single string?
questions.ground_truth: Use CONCAT(), e.g. CONCAT(name, ' <', email, '>').

questions.question: What is the default mode for transactions in MySQL and how do I turn it off?
questions.ground_truth: MySQL runs in AutoCommit mode by default; turn it off with SET autocommit = 0.

questions.question: How do I undo changes made in a transaction?
questions.ground_truth: Use ROLLBACK, which undoes all changes since the last COMMIT or ROLLBACK.
must_contain: undoes all changes since the last COMMIT

questions.question: How is a PRIMARY KEY different from a UNIQUE constraint?
questions.ground_truth: A table can have only one primary key, which cannot be NULL; UNIQUE can be used on several columns and allows NULLs.
must_contain: How Is PRIMARY KEY Different from UNIQUE

questions.question: How do I drop a UNIQUE constraint on the email column?
questions.ground_truth: ALTER TABLE users DROP INDEX email.

questions.question: How do I change the starting value of AUTO_INCREMENT?
questions.ground_truth: ALTER TABLE users AUTO_INCREMENT = 1000.

questions.question: How do I create a foreign key that links addresses to users?
questions.ground_truth: Add FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) in the addresses table.

questions.question: What does ON DELETE CASCADE do?
questions.ground_truth: It automatically deletes the related rows in the child table when the parent row is deleted.
must_contain: Deletes all related rows in child table

questions.question: What is the default ON DELETE behavior of a foreign key?
questions.ground_truth: RESTRICT: it prevents deleting the parent row if child rows exist.
must_contain: Prevents deletion of parent if child exists

questions.question: What does an INNER JOIN return?
questions.ground_truth: Only the rows that match in both tables.
must_contain: Returns only the matching rows from both tables

questions.question: What does a LEFT JOIN return when there is no match on the right?
questions.ground_truth: All rows from the left table, with NULLs for columns of the right table.
must_contain: Returns all rows from the left table

questions.question: What is the difference between UNION and UNION ALL?
questions.ground_truth: UNION removes duplicates; UNION ALL keeps them.

questions.question: What rules must the SELECT statements in a UNION follow?
questions.ground_truth: They must have the same number of columns with compatible data types.

questions.question: What is a Self JOIN and when is it used?
questions.ground_truth: A regular join where the table is joined with itself, e.g. users and the user who referred them.

questions.question: Does a MySQL view store its own data?
questions.ground_truth: No, a view is a virtual table based on a SELECT query and always reflects the current data of the base tables.

questions.question: How do I delete a view?
questions.ground_truth: DROP VIEW view_name, e.g. DROP VIEW high_salary_users.

questions.question: How do I see which indexes exist on a table?
questions.ground_truth: SHOW INDEXES FROM users.

questions.question: Why does the order of columns matter in a multi-column index?
questions.ground_truth: The index works efficiently when the filter includes the first column; filtering only on the second column may not use it effectively.

questions.question: What are the downsides of adding indexes?
questions.ground_truth: They consume extra disk space and slightly slow down INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

questions.question: How do I find users who earn more than the average salary?
questions.ground_truth: Use a scalar subquery: WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM users).

questions.question: What is the difference between WHERE and HAVING?
questions.ground_truth: WHERE filters rows before grouping; HAVING filters groups after aggregation and can use aggregate functions.
must_contain: HAVING is used after groups are formed

questions.question: How do I get subtotals and a grand total with GROUP BY?
questions.ground_truth: Add WITH ROLLUP to the GROUP BY clause.

questions.question: Why must I change the DELIMITER when creating a stored procedure?
questions.ground_truth: Because statements inside the procedure also end with a semicolon, which would confuse MySQL, so a temporary delimiter like $$ is used.

questions.question: How do I run a stored procedure?
questions.ground_truth: Use CALL procedure_name(...), e.g. CALL AddUser(...).

questions.question: How do I remove a stored procedure?
questions.ground_truth: DROP PROCEDURE IF EXISTS AddUser.

questions.question: What is a trigger in MySQL?
questions.ground_truth: A stored program that runs automatically when an INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE happens on a table.

questions.question: What do NEW and OLD refer to inside a trigger?
questions.ground_truth: NEW refers to the new row (INSERT/UPDATE) and OLD refers to the old row (UPDATE/DELETE).

questions.question: What is the difference between TRUNCATE and DELETE?
questions.ground_truth: TRUNCATE removes all rows quickly but keeps the table structure; it is faster than DELETE FROM and cannot be rolled back in most cases.

questions.question: What is the difference between CHANGE and MODIFY when altering a column?
questions.ground_truth: CHANGE can rename a column and change its type; MODIFY only changes the data type.

questions.question: What does the _ wildcard match in a LIKE pattern?
questions.ground_truth: A single character.

questions.question: How do I create a stored function (CREATE FUNCTION) that returns a value in MySQL?
questions.ground_truth: NOT IN THE DOCUMENT: the handbook covers stored procedures, not stored functions. A good answer says it is not covered.

questions.question: What is a FULL OUTER JOIN and how do I write one in MySQL?
questions.ground_truth: NOT IN THE DOCUMENT: only INNER, LEFT, RIGHT and self joins are covered.

questions.question: How do I use window functions like ROW_NUMBER() or RANK()?
questions.ground_truth: NOT IN THE DOCUMENT: window functions are not covered.

questions.question: How do I set up MySQL replication between two servers?
questions.ground_truth: NOT IN THE DOCUMENT: replication is not covered.

questions.question: How do I install MySQL on macOS using Homebrew?
questions.ground_truth: NOT IN THE DOCUMENT: it only mentions the MySQL installer for Windows/macOS and apt for Ubuntu.
